name: What types of outdoor living spaces does AKN Design Group specialize in for Dallas–Fort Worth homeowners?

mainEntity.name: What types of outdoor living spaces does AKN Design Group specialize in for Dallas–Fort Worth homeowners?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in creating high-end outdoor living spaces that expand usable living areas for Dallas–Fort Worth homeowners. Our projects often include custom patios, pergolas, fully equipped outdoor kitchens with built-in grills and countertops, and features like fire pits or fireplaces. We coordinate all elements from hardscaping to lighting and ceiling fans, transforming underused backyards into defined destinations for relaxation and entertaining. Our local expertise ensures designs are optimized for the DFW climate and lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group specializes in high-end outdoor living spaces for DFW homeowners, including custom patios, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, fire features, and comprehensive landscaping. We ensure designs are optimized for the local climate and lifestyle.
